Chapter 9: Aligning Actions with Core Values
As we dive deeper into this framework, there’s something that really matters—making sure our daily actions line up with our core values.
Think of your values as your inner compass. They quietly guide your decisions, help you set your priorities, and give a sense of purpose to everything you do.
When your actions match up with what’s truly important to you, life just feels right—coherent and meaningful. But when there’s a gap between the two, it’s easy to feel unsettled or even dissatisfied.
So, how do you figure out what your core values actually are?
Start with some honest self-reflection and ask yourself, “What really matters to me?”—not what other people expect, but what feels true in your gut.
Maybe you value integrity, compassion, creativity, or service. Whatever it is, let it come from your own sense of what’s right.
Once you’re clear on your values, try using them as a filter for your choices—big and small.
Picture this: someone who puts family first might turn down a big promotion to spend more time at home, while a person who values learning could take on a new challenge, even if it means risking failure.
It’s all about making choices that reflect who you really are.
Here are a few simple steps to keep your actions aligned with your values:
First, clarify your priorities. It helps to check in with yourself regularly, especially when tough decisions pop up.
Next, check for alignment. Before you commit to something, ask, “Does this reflect my values?”
And finally, course-correct gently. If you notice your actions drifting away from your values, make small adjustments, but don’t be hard on yourself.
Living in tune with your values brings a real sense of integrity and fulfillment.
It gives you a strong foundation, especially during uncertain times, making it easier to handle competing demands and outside pressures.
Over time, this kind of alignment becomes a steady source of quiet confidence.
Even if you’re not sure how things will turn out, knowing you’re acting in line with your deepest principles can give you genuine reassurance and peace.
